_provenance: Synthetic fixture modelled on Cloud Run Admin API v2 responses for a migration job execution that completed successfully (one task). It reproduces the OBSERVED legacy API format and shape with FICTIONAL data; it is not a copy of any live payload and none of its identifiers or timestamps identify a real resource or run.

Observed (structure only): every key present in the task object (and only those) and in the execution object; field types (generation/observedGeneration as strings, counts as numbers); the condition types and completion states; lastAttemptResult carrying an empty status; the task image in configured-tag form while the execution image is in mirror.gcr.io digest form.

Observed absent from the task: uid, index, retried, reconciling, lastAttemptResult.exitCode, lastAttemptResult.termSignal, lastAttemptResult.status.code. Observed absent from the execution: runningCount, failedCount, cancelledCount, retriedCount, reconciling.
The tasks.list page held one task and no nextPageToken.

Fictional (synthetic placeholders, not observed values): the project id; the execution and task names and short-name suffixes; the execution uid; every timestamp (all dates are a synthetic 2025-01-01 and only their relative ordering and RFC 3339 format matter); etags; serviceAccount; vpcAccess and other address/network settings; timeout values. The task container's env and resources were stripped. The job and container image references are the module's generic default job name and public Fleet image references.

execution.parallelism, execution.template.maxRetries and execution.template.timeout are included because the gate's execution checks require them; their values here are the module's configured values.
